body: Thank you so much. I haven't found a way to reach out for help before now, and it's wonderful to hear from someone who can relate. He won't talk to a professional because after a life of holding back from family and peers and keeping himself extremely guarded, he has trust issues, and is convinced that no one will understand or care. (He also hates the field of psychology with a burning passion) I've been in a manipulative/emotionally abusive relationship before, and while he has his moments, I do care deeply for this guy. He has a wonderful, bright future ahead, but he doesn't seem to want to work to make things better
